description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeLicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, search functions, and allowed license retrieval related to employee licenses.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmployeeLicenseDao functionalities such as create, read, update, delete, and license searches within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test by creating a new EmployeeLicenseDao instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of an EmployeeLicense by employee and license IDs, checking license number and dates.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified employee licenses and verifies the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Checks searching for licenses for a specific employee and asserts the result count and types.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicenseWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching with a limit on the number of results returned.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Creates a new EmployeeLicense object, sets properties, saves it, and verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves an existing EmployeeLicense, modifies fields, saves, and verifies the updated data.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Checks the count of employee licenses matching search criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed licenses for employees with different employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Verifies count of allowed licenses for specific employees.
